items.title: OpenAI launches a new blog for science
items.summary: OpenAI 喺 11 月 15 日開設科學網誌，話會刊出公司、合作者同更廣泛科學界用 AI 做研究嘅成果、方法同研究者親身經驗。公司指近期模型已用於數學證明、物理同生物數據分析等，希望呢個網誌幫更多人了解同使用呢啲工具。
items.note: The OpenAI page shows only the date November 15, 2026, with no time; publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00 and the time is unknown.
items.imageAlt: Social card for OpenAI’s announcement of its new science blog

items.title: OpenAI science blog: a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model
items.summary: OpenAI 科學網誌首篇來稿由訪問科學家、加州大學聖塔芭芭拉分校物理學家 Nathaniel Craig 撰寫，講述佢同 GPT-6 Astra 合作，提出一個候選嘅標準模型非微擾格點定義。文章寫明呢個係原則上嘅構造，仍需專家審視，目前亦未證明喺有限格距下滿足反射正性，亦未完成連續時空上嘅完整定義。
items.note: The OpenAI page shows only the date November 15, 2026, with no time; publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00 and the time is unknown. The post describes a candidate construction, not a completed settlement of the problem.
items.imageAlt: Social card for OpenAI’s guest post on a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model

items.title: Hong Kong police start SmartView AI facial recognition today, chief says it will not be abused
items.summary: 香港警方「銳眼計劃」今日（16日）起啟動人工智能人面識別功能。處長周一鳴前一日喺電視節目表示，功能主要用嚟刑事偵查同尋找失蹤人士，特別係患有認知障礙症嘅長者，使用前要有制衡同審批，強調唔會隨便濫用；警方亦話正推進接入私營商場閉路電視，首階段預計約有4間商場加入。
items.note: Print edition dated 2026-11-16; exact time is unknown. The page og:image is a newspaper-page scan and the article photo is labelled a file photo, so imageUrl is omitted. This is an activation-day follow to the Nov 15 batch item on the scheduled start; new facts are the commissioner’s checks-and-balances remarks, use mainly for crime and missing persons (especially elderly with dementia), and about four malls in the first CCTV-integration phase. September’s “zero robberies” was attributed to the existing SmartView camera network, not to the new facial-recognition feature, and is not used as a claim about today’s launch.

items.title: Lingnan lecturer urges AI privacy guidelines for elderly care as companion robots collect conversations
items.summary: 嶺南大學高級講師蕭珮而指出，AI安老應用已由步態分析、健康監測同復康訓練，逐步伸延到生活支援同情感陪伴；大型語言模型雖然帶來更多對話同互動，但技術進步唔等於照顧質素提升，關鍵係產品可唔可以配合長者能力、生活習慣同實際需要。佢倡安老業訂立AI私隱指引，因為陪伴機械人會收集對話，長者未必知情。
items.note: Print edition dated 2026-11-16; site datePublished is 2026-11-16T00:00:00+08:00 and exact time is unknown. Summary uses the headline and the visible lead; the remainder of the article is paywalled.
items.imageAlt: A woman stands beside a robotic companion cat on display

items.title: CityU hosts first ITC-funded science lecture on AI robots
items.summary: 由大公文匯傳媒集團主辦、獲創新科技署資助嘅「創新科技科普講堂」星期日喺香港城市大學舉行首場活動，主題係用AI機械人推動創科普及教育，主辦方指有逾300人報名。整個項目圍繞人工智能與機械人、智能健康科技、智慧城市與能源科技，合共籌辦4場主題活動同9場科技巡展。
items.imageAlt: A student shakes hands with a humanoid robot at City University of Hong Kong

items.title: HK should prepare for an AI slowdown, commerce chief Algernon Yau says
items.summary: 商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺星期日喺商業電台節目表示，近期出口升勢係由人工智能發展帶動，但各國對AI發展意見唔同，呢股熱潮有可能稍為放緩，香港要密切留意全球趨勢、調整策略同繼續擴展貿易網絡。佢又提到，9月香港出口按年升近65%，係四十多年嚟最快嘅單月按年升幅。
items.imageAlt: Hong Kong commerce chief Algernon Yau speaking at a briefing

items.title: CUHK wins six iENA 2026 awards for AI robotics and smart healthcare projects
items.summary: 中文大學公布，旗下研究團隊喺德國紐倫堡舉行嘅iENA 2026國際發明展奪得六個獎項，包括兩面金獎同兩項特別大獎。得獎項目包括中大同衍生公司SOTA Robotics共同研發、具備全棧機械人技能學習技術嘅「具身管弦樂演奏人形機械人」，以及用於血管內治療嘅磁性微納機械人。
items.note: Official press release is dated 15 Nov 2026 only; time is unknown.
items.imageAlt: CUHK researchers pose with university banners at iENA 2026 in Nuremberg

items.title: Jensen Huang has discussed returning as Nvidia CEO, FT reports
items.summary: 《The Verge》引述《金融時報》報道，黃仁勳已同親信討論重返 Nvidia 行政總裁職位，部分矽谷人士同員工亦嘗試向董事會施壓；馬斯克同 Epic Games 行政總裁 Tim Sweeney 亦公開支持要求「請黃仁勳回來」嘅聯署。同一報道指 Megaspeed 發表聲明，稱 Alice Huang 已於 2025 年 8 月 30 日起離職，目前同公司再無職務關係。
items.note: The comeback discussion is attributed to the Financial Times citing people familiar with the matter. The Verge also notes that signatures on the public reinstatement letter are hard to verify. article:published_time is 2026-11-15T20:43:49+00:00.
items.imageAlt: Portrait of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang

items.title: Bessent calls for a 'dramatic shakeup' at Nvidia and an outside CEO
items.summary: 美國財政部長 Scott Bessent 周日接受 Fox News 訪問，呼籲 Nvidia 作出「大幅改組」，並建議董事會從公司以外物色新任行政總裁。佢質疑 Nvidia 嘅企業文化，以及公司是否為咗推高收入同盈利而推動疑似非法晶片銷售，並將情況比喻為若銀行未有合規，監管機構可能撤換多名高層。
items.note: article:published_time is 2026-11-15T16:49:11+0000. Bessent’s remarks were made on Fox News and reported by CNBC.
items.imageAlt: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent speaking at a press conference

items.title: Microsoft opens a Digital Innovation Center in Kuwait to support AI adoption
items.summary: Microsoft 宣布喺科威特開設 Microsoft Digital Innovation Center，同當地政府合作，為政府機構、企業、初創同學生提供 AI、雲端同網絡安全體驗同培訓，以配合「新科威特 2035」願景。科威特通訊及資訊科技國務大臣 Omar Saud Al-Omar 同 Microsoft 中東非洲總裁 Naim Yazbeck 均有就開幕發表講話。
items.note: Official article:published_time is 2026-11-15T12:37:17+00:00.
items.imageAlt: Image from Microsoft’s announcement of its Digital Innovation Center in Kuwait

items.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24 million seed round for AI image sensors
items.summary: TechCrunch 報道，印度半導體初創 Bharat Semi 完成 2,400 萬美元全股本種子輪，由 Info Edge Group、South Park Commons 同 Indus Bridge Ventures 領投，用來開發把影像擷取、處理同 AI 做喺同一塊晶片上嘅可編程感應器。公司仍未有收入，產品仍在開發，目標 2027 年開始商業量產；聯合創辦人稱已取得 General Atomics 同 Kaynes Semicon 嘅設計採用。
items.note: Design wins and the 2027 production target are attributed to the company in the TechCrunch interview. article:published_time is 2026-11-15T23:30:00+00:00.
items.imageAlt: Bharat Semi co-founders Vinayak Dalmia and Vrinda Kapoor

items.title: League of Legends will get a New Dawn overhaul in 2027
items.summary: Riot 公布《英雄聯盟》大型改版「New Dawn」，計劃 2027 年推出現代化用戶端、重製召喚峽谷畫面，以及新嘅英雄遊玩方式。更詳細情報將於 2027 年 1 月公布。
items.note: Kept once as news (PC). Used the later, precisely timestamped PC Gamer write-up (article:published_time 2026-11-15T17:45:48Z). The reveal itself was at Worlds 2026 on 14 Nov; GamesRadar (2026-11-15T13:14:45Z) and Riot's official New Dawn page also cover it. Sources say the overhaul is planned for 2027, with a full reveal in January 2027; no exact launch day.

items.title: Slay the Spire 2 is testing a new character, The Fool, plus two new modes
items.summary: 《Slay the Spire 2》公開測試分支已加入新角色 The Fool，以及較短嘅 Blitz 模式同高難度 Dread 模式。開發商 Mega Crit 表示，角色喺進入正式分支前仍會大幅調整內容同平衡。
items.note: The Fool and the new modes are on the public-beta / testing branch, not confirmed on the main branch. PC Gamer article:published_time 2026-11-15T16:00:00Z, converted to 2026-11-16T00:00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: The Fool from Slay the Spire 2 drawing a bow

items.title: Zelda Notes shares first-week play data for the Ocarina of Time Switch 2 remake
items.summary: 任天堂透過 Zelda Notes 公布《薩爾達傳說 時之笛》Switch 2 重製版一週全球遊玩數據，最多令玩家 Game Over 嘅係 ReDead／Gibdo，最常用嘅特殊道具則係鉤索。報道指平均通關時間約喺 20 小時以上。
items.note: Figures come from Nintendo Life's report of Zelda Notes app data; the article notes the numbers will change as more people finish the game. Average clear time is described as around the '20 hours+' mark, not a precise official statistic. Listed 7:30am on Sun 15 Nov 2026, treated as UK local / GMT, converted to 2026-11-15T15:30:00+08:00.

Listed 6:30am on Sun 15 Nov 2026, treated as UK local / GMT, converted to 2026-11-15T14:30:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Minecraft artwork accompanying the Nintendo Life report

items.title: Classic Xbox and Xbox 360 startup animations begin rolling out on November 15
items.summary: 為慶祝 Xbox 25 周年，官方確認原版 Xbox 開機動畫，以及 2005 與 2010 年兩款 Xbox 360 開機動畫，已開始向 Xbox Series 及 Xbox One 玩家分批推送。玩家可喺主機設定嘅 Startup 選項中切換，未必會即時見到新選項。
items.note: Genuine update on yesterday's uncertain patch-notes item (gaming-20261115-xbox-classic-startup-animations). Xbox officially confirmed the Nov 15 rollout and said it would go out throughout the day. Pure Xbox's 15 Nov 2026, 7:17pm UK update quotes the official @Xbox post; The Verge independently reported the same rollout at 19:21 UTC (03:21 HKT). Converted Pure Xbox's 19:17 GMT timestamp to 2026-11-16T03:17:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Xbox 25th anniversary startup animation artwork

items.title: Xbox says Project Helix is a console that can play PC games, not a PC
items.summary: Xbox 喺 25 周年紀念雜誌中，由下一代主管 Jason Ronald 說明 Project Helix 嘅設計目標，係「一部都可以玩 PC 遊戲嘅主機，而唔係一部都可以玩主機遊戲嘅 PC」。佢形容 Helix 要即時取用橫跨四個世代嘅 Xbox 遊戲庫，並以神經渲染等技術提升沉浸感，而非只追求 8K 或 240Hz。
items.note: No release date, price or form factor is given in the magazine quotes. Handheld-in-2027 / console-in-2028 comments in secondary coverage are rumour and are not used here. Platforms are omitted because the source describes unreleased next-gen hardware design goals and does not name a current shipping SKU. Official Xbox Wire datePublished 2026-11-15T17:01:00+00:00; Helix quotes from VP of Next Generation Jason Ronald were corroborated in Pure Xbox and IGN write-ups.
items.imageAlt: Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine cover mockup

items.title: Sega partially restores ALL.Net and Aime arcade services after November breach
items.summary: Sega Fave 宣布，11 月初因伺服器遭入侵而暫停嘅街機網路服務 ALL.Net 及 Aime，已有部分功能於 11 月 15 日恢復，《Ongeki》、《SEGA NET Mahjong MJ Arcade》等作品開始試驗性重開。其他未列明嘅 Sega 機種仍要繼續維修，下次報告預計 11 月 17 日上午公布。
items.note: This arcade-network incident (access from Nov 1–2, partial restore Nov 15) is distinct from the already-covered vendor breach that exposed 2.196 million Sega newsletter emails (Nov 10 batch). Official Sega announcement was 09:00 JST (08:00 HKT), 18 minutes before yesterday's batch cutoff; Automaton's report at 10:31 JST is after that cutoff. Platforms are omitted because this is an arcade-network service restoration and the article does not name home platforms.
items.imageAlt: Sega ALL.Net and Aime service restoration news image
